beer.beer_description:
For this years Stout Challenge entry we've brewed a milk stout that is layered with cacao and vanilla.

Ale, crystal, brown and chocolate malts form the malt base with lactose, cacao and vanilla added at the end of boil.

Luscious, smooth and moreish with a rich cacao and vanilla hit on the nose and in the mouth with just enough bitterness from the kettle additions of English Hop East Kent Goldings to balance out the sweetness.

items.badge_description: Hoppy International Beer Day! Beer is the common thread that connects us worldwide, bringing people together in a unique way. And beer has played a significant role in shaping countless of our most cherished memories. If there is one thing we've learned along the way: Beer is best when shared with others. Join us in recognizing remarkable breweries worldwide by unlocking the fresh 2026 International Beer Day Badge. And don't forget to follow us on Instagram @untappd so that you never miss the next badge drop!
Happy Untappd anniversary to you! Thanks for sticking around and drinking socially with us. Cheers! That's 13 years on Untappd!
